# Annex A - Formulas {#sec-annex-a}

This annex lists the formulas behind the simulation. All values are SI
units unless stated.

::: {.hidden}
$$
\def\celsius{\mathrm{^\circ C}}
\def\ms{\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}}
\def\hpa{\mathrm{hPa}}
\def\kmh{\mathrm{km\,h^{-1}}}
\def\pa{\mathrm{Pa}}
$$
:::

## Saturation vapour pressure (Buck 1996)

$$
e_s = 6.1121 \cdot \exp\left(\frac{(18.678 - T/234.5) \cdot T}{257.14 + T}\right)
$$ {#eq-buck}

Where $T$ is the temperature in $\celsius$ and $e_s$ is in $\hpa$.

## Actual vapour pressure

$$
e = e_s \cdot \frac{RH}{100}
$$ {#eq-vapour}

## Virtual temperature

$$
T_v = \frac{T_K}{1 - \frac{0.37802 \cdot e}{P}}
$$ {#eq-virtual-temp}

## Air density

$$
\rho = \frac{P_{Pa}}{R_d \cdot T_v}, \quad R_d = 287.05287 \, \frac{J}{kg \cdot K}
$$ {#eq-air-density}

The density $\rho$ from [@eq-air-density] drives the ballistics model:
a colder, drier, higher-pressure atmosphere is denser and slows the
round more.

## Wet-bulb temperature (Stull 2011)

$$
T_w = T \cdot \text{atan}(0.151977 \cdot \sqrt{RH + 8.313659}) + \text{atan}(T + RH) - \text{atan}(RH - 1.676331) + 0.00391838 \cdot RH^{1.5} \cdot \text{atan}(0.023101 \cdot RH) - 4.686035
$$ {#eq-wet-bulb}

The atan terms are in radians. SQF `atan` returns degrees, so each term is
multiplied by the factor `0.0174532925`.

## WBGT

$$
WBGT = 0.7 \cdot T_w + 0.2 \cdot T_g + 0.1 \cdot T
$$ {#eq-wbgt}

The globe temperature $T_g$ is $T + 15$ in full sun and $T$ in full shade,
interpolated by overcast. See [@eq-wet-bulb] for $T_w$.

## Wind chill (JAG/TTI)

$$
T_{wc} = 13.12 + 0.6215 \cdot T - 11.37 \cdot V^{0.16} + 0.3965 \cdot T \cdot V^{0.16}
$$ {#eq-wind-chill}

Where $V$ is wind speed in $\kmh$. Valid below 10 $\celsius$ and above
4.8 $\kmh$.

## Solar declination

$$
\delta = 23.45 \cdot \sin\left(\frac{360}{365} \cdot (doy + 284)\right)
$$ {#eq-solar-decl}

## Solar elevation

$$
\sin(\alpha) = \sin(\phi) \cdot \sin(\delta) + \cos(\phi) \cdot \cos(\delta) \cdot \cos(h)
$$ {#eq-solar-elev}

Where $\phi$ is latitude and $h$ is the hour angle
`(local_hour - 12) * 15` degrees. Radiation is `max(0, sin(alpha))`, scaled
by cloud transmission `1 - 0.75 * overcast`. The declination comes from
[@eq-solar-decl].

## Lapse rate

$$
\Delta T = -0.0065 \cdot \Delta z
$$ {#eq-lapse}

## Deterministic random (LCG)

$$
x_{n+1} = (x_n \cdot 1103515245 + 12345) \bmod 2^{31}
$$ {#eq-lcg}

The seed combines mission time and an event salt, so the value is identical
on every machine.

::: {.callout-important}
## Determinism guarantee

The LCG in [@eq-lcg] is the reason AEE gives identical results on every
client: the same seed produces the same value, so stochastic effects
(scent dispersion, turbulence) resolve identically regardless of machine.
:::
